name: Happiness 2
storyline:
It is now the last week of the school year.

You try your best to forget ''her'' and wait for the day you get to see her again.

It's difficult, it's really difficult.

But you can't be thinking about such things right now.

Your world, your timeline is in danger again!!

If you don't do something she won't even have a world to exist in again.

''Find the path that leads to ''Her''

or...

'' Forever be a slave to time?''

**
